title: Catching BETs by viruses.
authors: Zandian, Mohamad; Chen, Irene P; Byrareddy, Siddappa N; Fujimori, Danica Galonic; Ott, Melanie; Kutateladze, Tatiana G
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Gene regulatory mechanisms
one_liner_zh: 综述病毒蛋白劫持BET蛋白（含溴结构域-乙酰化组蛋白互作）的机制，涉及蛋白-染色质互作但非TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: Viruses use diverse tactics to hijack host cellular machineries to evade innate immune responses and maintain their life cycles. Being critical transcriptional regulators, human BET proteins are prominent targets of a growing number of viruses. The BET proteins associate with chromatin through the interaction of their bromodomains with acetylated histones, whereas the carboxy-terminal domains of these proteins contain docking sites for various human co-transcriptional regulators. The same docking sites however can be occupied by viral proteins that exploit the BET proteins to anchor their genome components to chromatin in the infected host cell. In this review we highlight the pathological functions of the BET proteins upon viral infection, focusing on the mechanisms underlying their direct interactions with viral proteins, such as the envelope protein from SARS-CoV-2.
abstract_zh: 病毒利用多种策略劫持宿主细胞机制，以逃逸先天免疫反应并维持其生命周期。作为关键的转录调控因子，人类BET蛋白正成为越来越多病毒的重要靶标。BET蛋白通过其溴结构域与乙酰化组蛋白的相互作用与染色质结合，而这些蛋白的羧基末端结构域则包含多种人类共转录调控因子的对接位点。然而，这些相同的对接位点也可能被病毒蛋白占据，病毒利用BET蛋白将其基因组组分锚定在受感染宿主细胞的染色质上。在本综述中，我们重点阐述BET蛋白在病毒感染时的病理功能，聚焦于它们与病毒蛋白（如SARS-CoV-2的包膜蛋白）直接相互作用的机制。
